description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a High Performance Computing (HPC) System Engineer to directly support our most sensitive programs. You will be a part of the team building and maintaining large scale HPC infrastructure. You will have the opportunity to work with and learn from some of the world’s best engineers and cybersecurity professionals as you help to implement cutting edge systems. You will work directly to support systems deployed across the globe in support of national security missions.

• Architect and deploy advanced GPU infrastructure, leading the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of cutting-edge NVIDIA hardware including H100, H200, and B200/B300 systems.

• Ability to rack, stack, cable, and configure physical servers and multi-node GPU systems from end to end.

• Configure HPC and AI environments, including job schedulers (e.g., Slurm), multi-user login environments, and cluster management software (e.g., Warewulf, NVIDIA Base Command, RunAI).

• Implement and fine-tune high-speed interconnects (e.g., NVLink, NVSwitch, InfiniBand/NDR) crucial for large-scale distributed training.

• Configure and manage large-scale, high-performance storage platforms in the multiple petabytes range, optimized for AI/ML data access patterns.

• Install, configure, and maintain the application stack on HPC clusters, including traditional simulation software (StarCCM+, Ansys, Matlab) and the core AI/ML software stack (NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, PyTorch, TensorFlow).

• Implement and manage GPU virtualization and sharing technologies, such as Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), to maximize resource utilization across diverse workloads.

• Troubleshoot complex, system-wide issues related to application performance, user access, compute nodes, storage, and job queueing services.

• Utilize NVIDIA Data Center GPU Manager (DCGM) and additional tools to proactively monitor GPU health and performance, diagnosing and resolving training bottlenecks in collaboration with ML engineers.

• Ensure the security and integrity of the server and cluster infrastructure through regular audits, patching, and proactive security measures.

• Collaborate closely with engineering and AI/ML research stakeholders to gather requirements and architect robust, scalable solutions.

• Manage the hardware lifecycle, from quoting and procuring hardware from vendors to creating and executing deployment schedules.

• Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and architectural leadership to other team members.

• 5+ years of experience in designing, developing, and implementing large scale compute enterprise systems and solutions

• Proven expertise in one or more of the following, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Ubuntu, HPC, GPU, Azure or AWS cloud services

title: Employee Relations Partner
tags: Legal and Business Affairs : Legal : Legal
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Anduril, we build the hardware that defines the mission. Arsenal-1 is our advanced manufacturing facility, and its hourly production workforce - operators, technicians, and frontline managers - is the engine behind everything we ship. 

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a floor-first Employee Relations Specialist to own investigations and proactive ER programs for Arsenal-1's production workforce. You'll run a steady caseload end-to-end while standing up the manager training, trend analysis, and culture initiatives that let the site scale without scaling risk. The split is roughly 60% casework, 40% building. The ER framework exists; you're executing it, pressure-testing it, and improving it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Investigations & Casework:

• Own end-to-end workplace investigations for Arsenal-1's hourly workforce: intake, evidence gathering, interviews, findings, written reports, and recommendations across the full spectrum - policy violations, discrimination, harassment, improper conduct, theft, fraud

• Deliver investigation reports that hold up to Legal and senior leadership review - clear narrative, sound analysis, defensible conclusions

• Partner with PBPs on case review and recommendations; the business makes the final call on outcomes

• Flag risk early and work effectively with in-house employment counsel (and outside counsel when needed) to navigate sensitive or escalating matters

Floor Presence & Relationship Building:

• Build trusted, in-person relationships with frontline managers and shift leads - many operators don't have laptops or Zoom, so you have to be physically present

• Serve as a credible, approachable resource for managers navigating employee issues before they become formal complaints

• Get in front of trends: if a team is generating repeat complaints, you're having the conversation with their manager about expectations, not waiting for the next intake

Program Building & Scale:

• Operationalize and improve the existing investigation workflow - build consistency, documentation standards, and tracking as caseload grows

• Design and deliver proactive ER programs: manager training on policies and behavioral expectations, harassment prevention, investigation awareness

• Identify patterns across casework and translate them into actionable recommendations for PBPs and site leadership

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 4+ years of workplace investigations and employee relations advisory experience - you can run a case solo on day one, intake through written report and recommendation

• Direct experience supporting hourly/non-exempt workforces in production, manufacturing, warehousing, or distribution environments

• Strong written and verbal communication - investigation reports are BLUF, structured for a Legal and leadership audience

• Employment law fluency - you know policy, can interpret it, can spot risk, and have good instincts for when to loop in counsel

• Self-sufficient operator who has worked in environments where the playbook wasn't fully built and the manager wasn't co-located

• Program-building experience - you've built or meaningfully improved ER training, investigation processes, or proactive manager education programs

• Comfortable with ambiguity

title: Security Engineer, Infrastructure Security
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Our customers trust us with audio, video and data belonging to their own end users, so a security failure on our side puts their data and their business at risk. We are hiring an Infrastructure Security Engineer to improve the security posture of the production platform that carries that data. You will join a small Trust team that covers security, IT and compliance, and you will own real parts of the program from your first week. You will build our understanding of infrastructure security posture, then prioritize and drive remediation by business impact. Where the same class of problem keeps coming back, you will build the guardrails and security building blocks that let our security scale with the business.

YOU'LL THRIVE AT LIVEKIT IF YOU

- think like both a builder and a breaker, and understand security from first principles

- take an automation-first and pragmatic approach to risk mitigation

- translate security concerns into engineering action

- can clearly explain complex technical concepts to others

- are a fast learner and thrive in ambiguity

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Map the security posture of our cloud and production infrastructure and turn it into a documented baseline.

- Find the gaps that could lead to customer data loss or infrastructure compromise, agree a prioritized security debt backlog with engineering, and close the highest-risk items first.

- Harden identity, secrets and network boundaries, including cloud IAM, environment separation and credential hygiene.

- Secure the infrastructure that runs customer-deployed voice AI agents: tenant isolation, secrets for third-party model providers, and media and recording storage.

- Build guardrails and secure defaults into our infrastructure as code so the secure path is the easy one for engineers.

- Partner with our Compliance team to map infrastructure controls to PCI-DSS and ISO 27001 and automate the technical evidence those audits depend on.

WHO YOU ARE

- 5+ years in security engineering, infrastructure engineering or SRE, with a significant share of that focused on infrastructure security.

- Hands-on experience securing a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP or Azure) and containerized workloads including Kubernetes.

- A track record of owning infrastructure security for a production platform.

- Fluency with infrastructure as code such as Terraform, and strong scripting and automation skills in a language such as Go or Python.

- A pragmatic approach to risk: you can explain why a finding matters to the business and how fast it needs to be fixed.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with real-time media, networking or WebRTC systems.

- Experience in AI security, such as securing LLM applications or agent infrastructure.

- Incident response or application security experience.

- Experience supporting compliance audits such as PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2 or HIPAA.

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

- An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

- Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

title: Medical Coder
company: ClearSky Rehabilitation Hospital of Harker Heights, LLC
description:
Our hospital provides high-quality care that transforms the lives of those living with disabling injuries and illnesses. We distinguish ourselves through our commitment to excellence, to our patients, to our employees, and to the communities we serve. The Medical Coder reviews and assigns diagnostic and procedure codes to patient records for reimbursement and data purposes, in keeping with state and federal regulations. This position must integrate company values into daily practice.
Essential Functions Include:

• Assigns codes using the International Classification of Disease-10th Revision-Clinical modification (ICD-10-CM).

• Ensures codes are accurate and sequenced correctly in accordance with government and insurance regulations.

• Maintains a 95% threshold for coding accuracy.

• Receives and reviews patient charts and documents for accuracy. Identifies discrepancies and follows up with the provider on any documentation that is insufficient or unclear.

• Queries physician for clarification and diagnostic details as needed for accuracy and specificity in coding.

• Remains up-to-date and knowledgeable of coding and diagnostic procedures and remains current on federal legislative changes.

• Complies with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA), to protect patient confidentiality.

Minimum Job Requirements
Minimal Education & Experience:

• 3 years medical coding experience OR Coding certification (AHIMA or AAPC) required.

• Rehabilitation coding experience preferred.

• Associate's degree in related field preferred.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Current knowledge of CPT and ICD-10 coding principles, government regulations, protocols, and third party payer requirements regarding coding and billing.

• Working knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, and physiology.

• Knowledge of state and federal regulatory guidelines for reimbursement in the prospective payment system to interface with physicians.

Physical Requirements Over the Course of a Shift

• A significant amount of sitting and reaching.

• Lifting/exerting of up to 10 lbs.

• Sufficient manual dexterity to operate equipment and computer keyboard.

• Close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

• Ability to hear overhead pages.

title: Vehicle Operations Specialist
description:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing

Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.

The Role

We are looking for a Vehicle Operations Specialist to join our growing Vehicle Operations team as our fleet continues to scale.

Based within our Downtime team, this role will focus on the performance and commercial management of our hire vehicle portfolio, while also supporting wider operational reporting and process improvement across Vehicle Operations.

You will work closely with Vehicle Operations Specialists, Team Leads and external partners to ensure hire vehicles are managed effectively, recovery opportunities are followed through and agreed processes are being followed.

This role requires someone who is commercially minded, organised, confident working with data and comfortable challenging others constructively when performance or processes are not where they need to be.

You will also play an important role in helping us improve how we work, using data, technology and new ideas to build more effective and scalable processes.

What you'll do...

Manage Hire Vehicle Performance

Maintain oversight of hire vehicles across active cases, ensuring we have clear visibility of hire duration, cost, extensions, expected repair timelines and next actions.

Identify aged, high-cost or unusual cases and work with the team to reduce avoidable spend while ensuring drivers remain appropriately supported.

Support Cost Recovery

Track recovery opportunities and outstanding contributions from manufacturers, dealerships and partners.

Vehicle Operations Specialists will remain responsible for leading commercial conversations, while you will provide the administration, tracking and follow-up needed to ensure agreed processes are completed and money is actively chased.

You will help maintain clear visibility of amounts requested, agreed, received and outstanding.

Analyse Operational Performance

Use operational data to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities across Downtime and the wider Operations department.

This may include reviewing hire costs, aged cases, recovery performance, supplier performance, process compliance and operational workloads.

Turn data into clear insights and actions rather than simply maintaining reports.

Build and Maintain Reporting

Create, maintain and improve trackers, reports and dashboards using tools such as Excel and Google Sheets.

Ensure data is accurate, accessible and useful, and look for opportunities to simplify or automate manual reporting wherever possible.

Provide Feedback and Create Accountability

Identify where actions, processes or expectations have not been followed and provide constructive feedback to Vehicle Operations Specialists.

You will need to be confident holding people accountable for agreed actions while maintaining strong and positive working relationships.

The aim is always to improve performance and consistency, not simply identify mistakes.

Improve Processes

Look for opportunities to improve the way we work.

You should be able to take an existing process or project, understand where it could be stronger and help develop it into something more efficient, scalable and innovative.

This may involve improving controls, redesigning workflows, introducing better reporting or using new technology to reduce manual work.

Use Technology and AI Effectively

Be confident using technology and learning new systems.

Experience using AI or automation tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot or similar would be advantageous, particularly where they have been used to improve reporting, analysis or productivity.

You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious about how technology can improve operational performance.

Support Repair Progress Where Required

Repair chasing will not be the primary focus of the role, but there will be occasions where you need to contact dealerships, manufacturers, repairers or other partners to understand delays or resolve blockers affecting hire

​​Centralized monitoring is an integral part of a risk-based monitoring strategy, defined as the timely, remote review of accumulating subject and operational data to help distinguish between reliable and unreliable data, trends, outliers, and unusual variability using analytics and statistical methods.
The central monitor is responsible for conducting a holistic and centralized statistical review of study data from study start through to study database lock according to the centralized monitoring plan, using analytical tools to identify emerging and existing risks to critical study data and process. The central monitor enables proactive identification, communication, escalation and management of risks at the study/country/site level. ​
RESPONSIBILITIES

• ​​Follow established procedures for the review of clinical trial data (Operational and Subject data) using a variety of tools and systems in alignment with the centralized monitoring plan and with support from the senior team members.

• ​Identify data quality trends indicative of systematic errors and potential performance issues at study/country/site and track the evidence of issues and potential risks with support from senior team members.

• ​Ensure results of reviews are appropriately documented per procedures.

• ​Support Central Monitoring teams with performance of assigned reviews with high quality, on-time results.

• ​Provide input to senior team member as needed to support development of risk characterization and reporting.

• ​Support review set-up as directed by assigned lead including updating department database, pulling reports, etc. as assigned.

• ​Share the responsibility for data quality at the study, country and site levels.​

Requirements
Education

• ​​Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research.
Experience

• ​Minimum of 1 year of experience in central statistical monitoring with overall 6 years of experience in two or more operational areas such as clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety, medical monitoring, biometrics, or project management.

• ​Basic understanding of statistical monitoring and Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) and their impact on data integrity.

• ​Thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations.

• ​Knowledge of clinical trial database systems (EDC, IRT, CTMS, etc.).

• ​Good computer skills, with knowledge of advanced MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and the ability to learn and use interactive computer systems and tools.

• ​Ideally a basic level of understanding of descriptive analysis e.g. means, medians, significance, confidence intervals.

• ​Must have been involved in the analysis and review of clinical data, ability to extract pertinent information from standard study documentation, such as protocols, electronic study data systems with the ability to learn to identify trending of site/study data.

• ​Must be able to work in non-traditional work environments.

Attributes

• Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).

• Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels in an organization and with external customers.

• Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.

• Prioritization skills with ability to plan, monitor and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.

• Satisfactory understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.

• Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.

• Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.

• Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems.

• Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds - they should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.

At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

description:
(This job is only available in german)
Worum es geht
SIMON ist die Außendienst-Plattform für alle, die beim Kunden vor Ort arbeiten. Das reicht von der Pharmareferentin in der Apotheke über den Merchandiser im Lebensmittelmarkt bis zum Techniker im Heizungskeller. Jetzt bringen wir SIMON zu weiteren mittelständischen Herstellern, vor allem im Handel und FMCG sowie im technischen Kundendienst. Dafür suchen wir dich: jemanden, der die richtigen Leute findet, anspricht und vom ersten Kontakt bis zum produktiven Einsatz begleitet.
Wie wir verkaufen
Wir verkaufen SIMON so, wie man einen neuen Kollegen einstellt. Zuerst kommt das Kennenlernen: Der Interessent probiert einen Prototyp für seine Branche selbst aus. Darauf folgt das Vorstellungsgespräch, eine Demo mit einem Klickdummy in seinen eigenen Begriffen. Danach kommt die Probearbeit, ein Pilot mit fünf bis zehn Nutzern und vorab vereinbarten Erfolgskriterien. Erst dann folgt die Festanstellung, also Vertrag und Rollout. Was du mitbringst

title: Senior Media Buyer
description:
Job Title: MVA Lead Generation Senior Media Buyer

I want to hire you… and pay you a lot of money.

But this role isn't for most media buyers.

If you’re a senior media buyer based in the U.S. who is already actively managing accounts spending 7 figures per month on Meta and/or Google , keep reading.

Because if you're genuinely elite at media buying, obsessed with performance, and want to operate at a scale where small improvements can have massive impact, this could be the opportunity you're looking for.

We operate at serious scale.

You'll be working across 7-figure monthly advertising budgets , multiple platforms, multiple states and markets, and a creative operation capable of producing and testing a massive volume of new ads.

We don't need someone to simply maintain what we've built.

We want someone who can help us make it significantly better.

The Role

This is not a traditional media buyer role.

We don't need someone who waits for instructions, adjusts budgets, turns off bad ads, and calls it media buying.

And we definitely don't need someone who requires leadership to constantly tell them where the next opportunity is.

We're looking for someone who can take real ownership over performance.

Someone who can look across Meta, Google, states, campaigns, and hundreds of creatives and quickly determine:

• Where should we spend more?

• Where should we spend less?

• What's starting to work that we haven't fully capitalized on yet?

• Why is this state underperforming?

• What winning ads haven't we expanded yet?

• What creative are we missing?

• What should we test next?

Then actually execute.

You won't just optimize campaigns.

You'll help determine where the next level of growth comes from.

What You’ll Actually Own

1. Performance & Scaling

• You’ll help manage and optimize high-spend campaigns across Meta and Google , including YouTube, Search, and Performance Max.

• You'll continuously look across platforms and states to identify:

• Scaling opportunities

• Budget reallocation opportunities

• Performance inefficiencies

• Underperforming markets

• Testing gaps

• New strategies worth implementing

We expect you to understand where our money is going, what it's producing, and where the next dollar should be spent.

You'll work with other media buyers and leadership on cross-platform and state-level budget strategy to hit our volume and profitability goals.

2. Creative Expansion

At our scale, media buying and creative strategy cannot operate separately.

You'll know our best-performing ads.

You'll know our best-performing angles.

You'll know which concepts are starting to gain traction.

And you'll make sure we capitalize on them.

That means constantly thinking:

“This is working here → why aren't we running it here, here, and here?”

“This angle is crushing on Meta → let's test it on YouTube.”

“This state-specific concept is working → let's build it for every relevant market.”

“We're relying too heavily on UGC here → let's expand our creative diversity.”

“This angle is starting to work → creative team needs to build 10 more variations before everyone else catches it.”

You’ll bridge the gap between performance data and the creative team.

The creative team should always know what’s working, what’s starting to work, what’s getting fatigued, and what we need more of.

3. Underperforming Markets

When a state isn't producing enough volume, your job isn't simply to say:

"Performance is bad."

Your job is to figure out why.

Is it creative?

Campaign structure?

Budget allocation?

Lack of creative diversity?

A winning angle we haven't brought over from another market?

Platform mix?

Audience?

Offer?

Landing page?

Then build and execute a plan to improve it.

We want problem solvers, not reporters.

4. Media Buying Operations

You'll help own the operational side of running advertising at scale.

That includes:

• Weekly and monthly spend planning and pacing

• Cross-platform and state-level b

title: Senior Machine Learning Applications and Compiler Engineer, LPX
description:
We are now looking for a Senior Machine Learning Applications and Compiler Engineer!
NVIDIA is seeking engineers to develop algorithms and optimizations for our LPX inference and compiler stack. You will work at the intersection of large-scale systems, compilers, and deep learning, crafting how neural network workloads map onto future NVIDIA platforms. This is your chance to be part of something outstandingly innovative!
What you’ll be doing:

• Build, develop, and maintain high-performance runtime and compiler components, focusing on end-to-end inference optimization.

• Define and implement mappings of large-scale inference workloads onto NVIDIA ’s systems.

• Extend and integrate with NVIDIA ’s SW ecosystem, contributing to libraries, tooling, and interfaces that enable seamless deployment of models across platforms.

• Benchmark, profile, and monitor key performance and efficiency metrics to ensure the compiler generates efficient mappings of neural network graphs to our inference hardware.

• Collaborate closely with hardware architects and design teams to feedback software observations, influence future architectures, and codesign features that unlock new performance and efficiency points.

• Prototype and evaluate new compilation and runtime techniques, including graph transformations, scheduling strategies, and memory/layout optimizations tailored to spatial processors.

• Publish and present technical work on novel compilation approaches for inference and related spatial accelerators at top tier ML, compiler, and computer architecture venues.

What we need to see:

• MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience, with 5 years of relevant experience.

• Strong software engineering background with proficiency in systems level programming (e.g., C/C++ and/or Rust) and solid CS fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and concurrency.

• Hands on experience with compiler or runtime development, including IR design, optimization passes, or code generation.

• Experience with LLVM and/or MLIR, including building custom passes, dialects, or integrations.

• Familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch, and experience working with portable graph formats such as ONNX.

• Solid understanding of parallel and heterogeneous compute architectures, such as GPUs, spatial accelerators, or other domain specific processors.

• Strong analytical and debugging skills, with experience using profiling, tracing, and benchmarking tools to drive performance improvements.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across hardware, systems, and software teams.

• Ideal candidates will have direct experience with MLIR based compilers or other multilevel IR stacks, especially in the context of graph based deep learning workloads.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Prior work on spatial or dataflow architectures, including static scheduling, pipeline parallelism, or tensor parallelism at scale.

• Contributions to opensource ML frameworks, compilers, or runtime systems, particularly in areas related to performance or scalability.

• Demonstrated research impact, such as publications or presentations at conferences like PLDI, CGO, ASPLOS, ISCA, MICRO, MLSys, NeurIPS, or similar.

• Experience with large-scale AI distributed inference or training systems, including performance modeling and capacity planning for multi rack deployments.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
135,000 CAD - 185,000 CAD for Level 3; and 170,000 CAD - 220,000 CAD for Level 4. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 3, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
About Improvado

Improvado is a marketing data and AI analytics platform for enterprise brands and agencies. We connect 500+ marketing and sales data sources, normalize them through a governed data model, and put an AI agent on top so marketing teams can ask questions of their own data without going through BI or IT.
What we sell: extraction and 500+ connectors; data transformation (SQL and dbt-compatible); Marketing Data Governance - taxonomy, naming, data-quality rules; warehouse and storage; dashboards; AI agent and MCP access to live marketing data; DECS, data engineering as a service on a 2 to 4 week SLA.
Who buys it:

•
Economic buyers: CMO, VP Marketing, VP Demand Gen, agency COO and ops leadership

•
Technical evaluators: VP or Director of Marketing Analytics, marketing analysts, data engineering, sometimes IT and security

•
Segments: enterprise brands, mid-market, agencies

•
Verticals: pharma and healthcare, financial services, retail and eCommerce, gaming, agencies

Why this role, now

•
Our messaging is not aligned. Positioning, web, sales pitch, product and content each carry a different version of what Improvado is. The market categorizes us as "marketing ETL" while we position as an AI marketing analytics platform. That gap costs us deal quality and price.

•
The category is crowded and moving fast. Battlecards exist but decay, and nobody owns keeping them true.

•
Attribution, incrementality and causal measurement is where deals are won and lost - and it is the hardest thing to argue credibly without hand-waving.

•
Analyst firms are a silent blocker. When an enterprise buyer asks Gartner or Forrester about Improvado , there is no briefed narrative waiting for them.

You would not start from a blank page. We already have a positioning registry, roughly 11 documented buyer personas, a pain-point and value-prop library, competitor intel reports and about 10 battlecards. They are inconsistent and under-used. Your first job is to make one version true and make people use it.
What you'll own

•
Positioning and messaging. Core positioning, category framing and message hierarchy across ICPs and personas. ICP and persona documentation that is used, not filed. The messaging layer of new product and feature launches, including the internal rollout that makes the field able to sell it.

•
Competitive intelligence and win/loss. A structured win/loss interview program with quarterly readouts. Living battlecards. Monitoring competitor positioning, pricing and product moves, and driving our counter-positioning.

•
Sales enablement. The core pitch narrative, demo storyline and objection-handling framework. The messaging components of new-rep onboarding. A standing weekly cadence with Sales leadership - not quarterly check-ins. Direct support on competitive and enterprise deals: RFPs, security and technical evaluations, displacement plays.

•
Market and analyst relations. The Improvado narrative for Gartner, Forrester and category influencers, so that a buyer's analyst call becomes an accelerator rather than a blocker. Feeding structured market and buyer insight back into product prioritization.

What we're looking for

• 4 to 8 years in product marketing, or an equivalent blend of product marketing with marketing analytics, marketing or data ops, sales engineering, analytics consulting, or product management on a data product.

• Category fluency in marketing data and measurement: attribution models, incrementality testing, MMM, data governance and taxonomy, warehouses and ETL/ELT - including where each is honestly weak.

• B2B SaaS sold to marketing or data buyers. Marketing analytics, martech, measurement, CDP, BI and data-infrastructure vendors are the reference profile.

• Proof you have shipped, not just documented: positioning that changed the website and the pitch, battlecards reps actually opened, a win/loss program that survived past its second quarter.

• Writing that survives contact with a skeptical technical buye

ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

YOUR ROLE

As a Senior Technical Support Engineer (TSE) on the Customer team, you play a mission-critical role in ensuring our customers receive fast, accurate, and technically excellent support. You serve as the highest internal technical escalation point, combining deep product mastery with a strong ability to diagnose complex issues across integrations, workflows, and customer environments.

You are the connective tissue between Support, Product, and Engineering, ensuring issues are surfaced with clear repro steps, impact assessments, and prioritization signals. You lead with operational rigor-improving processes, eliminating inefficiencies, and strengthening the pathways from customer-reported issues to engineering resolution.

In this role, you’ll become an expert across Zip’s rapidly expanding ecosystem-Procurement, Intake, Approvals, Suppliers, ERP and SSO integrations, and our broader workflow engine-while directly supporting marquee customers including Coinbase, Snowflake, Notion, Canva, Samsara, and Databricks.

Your impact will scale as Zip grows: every improvement you introduce strengthens the technical foundation of our entire Customer organization.

YOU WILL

Technical Escalation & Issue Resolution

- Serve as the final technical escalation point for Support, unblocking TSEs, CSMs, and onboarding teams with expert-level troubleshooting.

- Triage and validate bugs, perform deep-dive investigations, reproduce issues, and determine ownership before routing to Engineering with complete context.

- Partner directly with Engineering to master Zip’s architecture, including workflow nodes, task engines, integrations, and API layers.

Operational Excellence & Process Ownership

- Identify, build, and maintain scalable escalation pathways from Customer → Product → Engineering.

- Strengthen internal triage processes by closing knowledge gaps, improving documentation, and optimizing tooling and workflows.

- Develop clear standards for debugging, ticket handoffs, reproduction steps, and prioritization signals to improve Engineering alignment and SLA predictability.

Customer Advocacy & Cross-Functional Partnership

- Collaborate with Product as the voice of the customer, influencing roadmap decisions through patterns surfaced in escalations.

- Work directly with customers when highly technical or urgent issues require senior-level expertise.

- Support Sales, CSM, Onboarding, and TAM functions as a subject-matter expert across procurement workflows, integrations, and system configurations.

Data & Tooling

- Use internal tools, logs, and observability platforms (e.g., DataDog) to analyze customer configurations, trace failures, and understand system behavior.

- Validate integration flows using REST/GraphQL payloads, webhooks, APIs, and third-party systems.

- Drive improvements by identifying systemic issues from recurring case patterns.

QUALIFICATIONS

- 5-6 years in a technical, customer-facing role, with at least 2 years serving as an escalation point or senior technical leader within Support.

• Lead, develop, and retain a senior, high-performing communications organization, setting a high bar for craft and a culture of learning from both wins and misses

• Own the communications budget and headcount, allocating resources against the company’s highest-priority narratives and moments

• Define the metrics that matter for reputation and communications impact, and use them to guide investment and strategy

• Champion the adoption of AI across the communications function, including AI-powered media monitoring, sentiment analysis, and content development, to increase speed, insight, and scale

description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for a Strategic Partnerships Lead to own multi-threaded strategic partnerships and carry those negotiations from structuring through signature and into the field. This is a senior individual contributor role. It is not a program role.

You will work with two kinds of partners: Large, publicly traded ISVs, where one relationship covers the product integration, the commercial agreement, and how both field teams take it to customers. And developer and infrastructure platforms, where you will expand our one-click motion: a customer clicks “Monitor with Grafana Cloud” in the partner product, we create or attach a Grafana Cloud account, and telemetry, dashboards, and alerting are provisioned without a manual setup.

You will recruit partners, work closely  with Product and Engineering teams on what gets built, negotiate the terms that make the integration hold, and work with Sales so the partnership shows up in real pursuits. 

This role reports to the Senior Director, Corporate Business Development.

What You’ll Be Doing:

- Own the plan for each partner, including which opportunities to pursue and which to pass on

- Scope product integrations with Product and Engineering, including one-click provisioning into Grafana Cloud, the telemetry and dashboards that come with them, and where Grafana shows up inside the partner product

- Lead negotiations through signature, covering revenue share, attribution, placement, co-sell, data and brand terms, and term length

- Run integration, commercial, and field workstreams together on large ISV partnerships, so a term in one workstream still works in the others

- Expand the “one-click” motion to additional partners, and structure the economics around the product surfaces that drive conversion

- Launch partnerships with the field, including enablement, account mapping, and a path for sellers to use the integration in a pursuit

- Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal from the first structuring conversation through launch

What Makes You a Great Fit:

- You have owned technology partnerships end to end, including the negotiation, with more than one live workstream in the same account

- You have closed integration partnerships that Product and Engineering had to build, and the commercial terms held after signature

- You have taken a partnership into the field, including the launch and seller enablement

- You are comfortable running several significant negotiations at the same time

- You work across Product, Engineering, Sales, Legal, and Finance without needing a team under you

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an IT Site Specialist to join our IT Team at Ramp based in our NYHQ office! This is a contract to hire full-time on-site role that blends hands-on, in-person site support, including remote support for end users based out of smaller offices and hubs. You’ll be joining the IT Operations pod that owns desk-side support, onboarding/offboarding, and user and office technology. We’re looking for someone who takes pride in having a service mindset while delivering team oriented results.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Provide in-person support at our NYHQ 5 days/week and remote support for our offices.

- Manage your IT ticket queue: triage incoming requests, set priorities, and keep response time fast without letting things fall through the cracks, while proactively seek ways to eliminate repeat requests through automation and process improvements

- Support office technology, including printers, conference room AV, and company all hands events

- Endpoint lifecycle: prep and facilitate provisioning of new hire laptops, fleet upgrades, retire end of life hardware, update asset records, and IT asset management

- Reduce repeat work by writing and maintaining IT documentation and help articles, and by building smaller automations with guidance from the team

- Take ownership of small and large projects, working with various internal/external teams to accomplish goals

- Contribute to IT projects in partnership with People, Security, Engineering, and other teams, and look for practical ways to use AI to improve support and IT operations

- Be an advocate for our users, understand their challenges, and look to remove blockers

WHAT YOU NEED

- Minimum 3 years of hands-on IT support experience, ideally in a fast-paced or high-growth environment

- Strong knowledge in our core tech stack including Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, JAMF, Intune, Zoom, and various modern SaaS tools

- Experience with desk side support, ticket resolution, and knowing when to escalate to an engineering team

- Some hands-on exposure to IT automation or workflow tools, and an eagerness to build more

- Practical AV and conference room experience, including large event support

- Demonstrated AI fluency: you use AI regularly in your work, have a clear point of view on where it helps and where it doesn’t, and are continuously raising your own bar

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical teammates

- Empathic, humble, and posses a strong focus on elevating end user experience

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience in high-growth startups

- Experience managing macOS/Windows in hybrid/remote environments.

- Familiarity with lightweight scripting (Bash, Python, etc.) or exposure to APIs and integrations

- Experience with AI-assisted support tooling and workflow automation (e.g., Serval or similar)

- Experience coordinating hardware procurement with fulfillment vendors (e.g., Firstbase, SHI, CDW)

- Google Workspace or Okta Administrator experience

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

About the Team

Activations is part of StackAdapt's Data Hub product, our customer data platform. Advertisers bring their first-party data into Data Hub: CRM lists, website and app events, product catalogs and store locations. Activations turn that data into something they can use. We build audiences, keep them in sync with the channels advertisers buy on, and feed products and locations into dynamic creative.

We are a small team of senior and mid-level engineers. We work mostly in Go, on event-driven services that run at large scale, using Kafka, gRPC and TiDB on AWS. Advertisers spend against the audiences we build, and privacy law shapes how we handle their data, so correctness matters as much as speed.

The team runs flat. Senior engineers lead projects from design to launch. You will set the technical standard those project leads work to: how we design, review and ship. You will help every engineer on the team get better at it, mostly by building alongside them.

You will work closely with our Data Hub architect, who sets technical direction across the whole domain and decides designs that cross Data Hub teams. You decide designs inside Activations, and the two of you work together on the ones that cross the line. You also own the technical calls the team makes day to day, and the case for changing direction when what we learn in production says we should.

What You'll Be Doing

• Owning the technical health of the team's systems. You will own audience evaluation, CRM and programmatic audience syncs, and the product and location feeds behind dynamic creative. You will decide where reliability, cost and tech debt work goes, and make the case for it on the roadmap.

• Building. You will write production code every week and take on the hardest work yourself: how we evaluate audiences at scale, how we keep long-running syncs reliable, and how activation grows beyond email to new identifiers.

• Setting the review bar. A growing share of our code is written with AI coding agents. You will define what a good review looks like when an agent wrote the first draft, review the risky changes yourself, and teach the team to catch what agents miss: concurrency, data correctness, idempotency, privacy.

• Coaching engineers. You will help senior engineers lead their own projects, and help mid-level engineers grow into senior ones. Expect to do this through design reviews, pairing and code reviews that teach.

• Making the team faster with AI, carefully. You will find where AI tools save real time for us, such as review assistants, test generation, runbooks and on-call triage. You will build or adopt those tools, measure whether they work, and drop the ones that don't.

• Turning product needs into technical plans. You will work with Product and the engineering teams around us to shape multi-month plans. You will find unknowns and cross-team dependencies early, and explain trade-offs in plain language.

• Leading on reliability. You will take part in the on-call rotation, lead root cause analysis for team incidents, and make sure the fixes hold. You will set the team's standards for testing, observability and alerting.

What You'll Bring to the Table

• 8+ years building backend systems, with several years as the engineer others turned to for design decisions on a team that owns production services.

• Strong Go, or deep experience in another backend language and a willingness to work in Go every day.

• Experience designing and running distributed, data-heav

- Develop designers' judgment and autonomy rather than becoming the final approval layer for every decision.

title: Manager, Manufacturing Optimization
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Manufacturing Operations Team plays a vital role in driving operational excellence and delivering high-quality products that support Anduril's mission of advancing defense capabilities.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Manufacturing Optimization Manager to support in the development and deployment of the Anduril Production System (APS) to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across our manufacturing sites in the US. This role will work closely with manufacturing/production leadership teams to develop, implement, and sustain lean manufacturing systems, coach frontline leaders, and build tools to help drive operational performance in the business.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in manufacturing operations and would have held roles leading production teams on a shop floor. The candidate should have a strong working knowledge and application of metric board tracking, KPI and target development, problem solving, and a demonstrated proficiency in daily management in a fast-paced, high-volume manufacturing setting. You will be responsible for building capabilities in frontline production leaders (Supervisor and Team Leader) and creating sustainable systems in Manufacturing Excellence that drive long-term performance improvements. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced manufacturing professional ready to make an impact by coaching, teaching, and developing others through a hands-on approach.

A successful candidate will be expected to work out of Costa Mesa, CA. Based on eligibility, relocation assistance may be available. Travel up to 50% may be required for training, cross-site collaboration, or supporting continuous improvement initiatives at other Anduril facilities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Establish a scalable operating/manufacturing/production system (tiered accountability, daily management, KPI trees, visual management, problem solving, governance) aligned to Safety, People, Quality, Delivery, and Cost

• Strengthen cross-functional execution by integrating Operations, Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, and Test into shared problem-solving and prioritized action plans

• Standardize processes, tools, and templates that will be used by all Operations teams across the company

• Coach and develop Managers, Supervisors and Team Leaders through daily Gemba, leader standard work, and structured feedback

• Capture and deploy best practices across lines/cells/sites via playbooks, standard work libraries, and replication mechanisms with clear ownership and audit cadence

• Develop practical tools and structures (dashboards, hour-by-hour boards, problem queues, skills boards) that improve visibility, prioritization, and decision speed

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of experience as a Production Supervisor or Manager running a shop floor in a high-volume environment

• Possesses strong working knowledge and application of LEAN tools and principles, 5S, and Six Sigma to eliminate waste

• Clear demonstration of scaling products from NPI to high volume

• Strong working knowledge of standard work development, writing, and creation for frontline hourly teams on the shop floor

• Organized and detail-oriented with excellent verbal & writte

title: Managed Payroll Lead
description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling , you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365-all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors-including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock-and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @ Rippling .com addresses.

About the role

Rippling is expanding its Managed Payroll offering in the US, and we’re looking for a Managed Payroll Lead to own and scale that effort. This is a rare opportunity to shape a service from its earliest stage - defining the operating model, setting the standard for delivery, and building the foundation for a best-in-class customer experience.

You will be both a hands-on operator and a people leader. In the near term, that means running payroll, owning client relationships, and sitting in the detail alongside your team. Over time, it means developing the people, processes, and infrastructure that allow the program to grow without sacrificing service quality.

Rippling is an AI-forward environment, and this role is no exception. Automation and AI-assisted workflows handle the busy work, freeing you and your team to focus on what matters most: delivering an exceptional customer experience and navigating the complexity that no tool can fully anticipate. Comfort with - and curiosity about - evolving technology is a must.

This role is right for someone who has led a managed or outsourced payroll team, thrives in ambiguity, and gets genuine satisfaction from building something from the ground up. You won’t have all the answers on day one - and that’s the point.

Please note we will not be hiring this position in the San Francisco Bay Area or New York City Metro

What you will do

• Team leadership & development

• Onboard and develop a team of US Managed Payroll Specialists, building capacity as the customer portfolio grows

This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the Workday Financials ecosystem.

As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems.

- Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing Workday, P2P, and financial systems expertise to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio.

- 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with Workday Financials.

- Strong foundational knowledge of core Workday Financials business processes, data models, and the Foundation
